reading.body:
Molina Healthcare operates an IT center in Albuquerque through a subsidiary, built to serve the company's own claims processing, member services, and health plan administration rather than as commercial colocation. The facility was announced in 2008 and appears to have been financed through state economic development mechanisms. No current megawatt capacity or operational specifications have been published by the operator.

This registry has not obtained published power or rack specifications for this facility. Without published figures, its scale relative to AI infrastructure buildout cannot be determined. New Mexico has 14 mapped data center facilities statewide, none with published megawatt figures in this registry's database.

A facility built eighteen years ago to serve healthcare claims processing does not indicate readiness for AI workloads unless substantially upgraded. The absence of published specifications means this campus does not factor into current assessments of where compute capacity for AI development exists or is coming online.
